usedFor: Membrain holds sales projects and opportunities, and MSG91 opens or answers a ticket through “Send Mail via Hello”.

bestTemplate.name: “Opportunity Is Updated” in Membrain, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: A changed opportunity can open a ticket, or reply on an existing one when you pass its ID.

watchOut: “Opportunity Is Updated” in Membrain is polling, so the ticket arrives after a scheduled check.
